sender.en: A new “friend” or “partner” from social media

name.bs: Ljubavna prevara: mjesecima gradi povjerenje, pa traži novac
name.en: Romance scam: builds trust for months, then asks for money

how.bs: Preko društvene mreže javlja se privlačna osoba, često navodno iz inostranstva. Mjesecima se dopisujete, nastaje bliskost i planovi za susret. Onda iskrsne problem: viza, hitno liječenje ili karta za put, i traži novac. Uplate se nastavljaju dok žrtva ne shvati da osoba ne postoji.
how.en: An attractive person gets in touch on social media, often supposedly from abroad. You chat for months, closeness grows and plans to meet are made. Then a problem comes up: a visa, urgent medical treatment or a travel ticket, and they ask for money. The payments continue until the victim realises the person doesn’t exist.

text.bs: Upoznavanje preko društvene mreže, mnogo pažnje.
text.en: Meeting on social media, lots of attention.
A sudden problem: a visa, a hospital, a ticket.

text.bs: Ljubavi, sve je spremno za moj dolazak, ali na aerodromu traže da platim taksu za vizu, a kartica mi ovdje ne radi. Treba mi 1.200 KM do sutra ujutro, inače propada let. Vratiću ti čim stignem, znaš da te volim.
text.en: My love, everything is ready for my arrival, but at the airport they want me to pay a visa fee and my card doesn’t work here. I need 1,200 KM by tomorrow morning, otherwise I miss the flight. I’ll pay you back as soon as I arrive, you know I love you.

bs: upoznala muškarca na facebooku traži novac
partner sa interneta treba novac za vizu
dopisujemo se mjesecima nikad video poziv
traži novac za kartu da dođe kod mene
en: met a man on facebook asking for money
online partner needs money for a visa
chatting for months never a video call
asking for money for a ticket to come to me

bs: Osoba koju nikad niste vidjeli uživo traži novac.
Uvijek ima izgovor za video poziv i susret.
Problemi koji iskrsnu tik pred susret.
en: Someone you’ve never met in person asks for money.
Always has an excuse to avoid a video call or meeting.
Problems that come up right before meeting.

bs: Ne šaljite novac osobi koju niste upoznali uživo.
Razgovarajte s nekim bliskim prije bilo kakve uplate.
Prekinite kontakt i prijavite policiji; ako ste uplatili, javite banci.
en: Don’t send money to someone you haven’t met in person.
Talk to someone close before any payment.
Cut off contact and report it to the police; if you paid, tell your bank.

sources.title: Drastičan porast online prevara u BiH, napadači koriste vještačku inteligenciju da vam otmu novac
